messages.subject: Checkboxes or buttons next to table for rows selecting/marking
parts:
Hi, 

I would like to add some kind of input next to table's rows. It could be buttons or checkboxes or etc. 
I calculate table from selected data and render it in application. However, some rows could be unnecessary, therefore I want user let mark which ones he doesn't want. 
Therefore, I need some kind of input for user, to select these. After selection, user would push, for example, 'Recalculate' actionButton and table will be recalculated and rendered with only selected rows.

Any suggestions would be great. 
Thank you!
